Game Overview

In Puppy vs Zombie, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the paws of a courageous puppy battling endless zombie waves in this exhilarating arcade runner. Master simple controls to dodge obstacles, outsmart roaming zombies, and score big. With increasing challenges and strategic maneuvers, the thrill never stops in your quest for survival and high scores.
